question.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$W=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 5 & 0 \\ 2 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 0 & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(W) & ={w}_{11}{C}_{11}+{w}_{12}{C}_{12}+{w}_{13}{C}_{13}+{w}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =1\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+5\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & ={C}_{11}+5{C}_{13} \\  & =1\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ ∗ & 3 & 0 & 4 \\ ∗ & 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|+5\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 5 & ∗ \\ 2 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & ∗ & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|+5\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|+5|\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 4 \\ 8 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 4 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|+5(2\cdot |\begin{aligned}3 & 4 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 8 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 \\ 8 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & =10(3\cdot (-2)-4\cdot 0) \\  & =10\cdot (-6) \\  & =-60\end{aligned}
$$
